---
title: "News"
listing:
  contents: "news/*.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  date-format: "MMM YYYY"
  fields: [date, image, title, description, categories]
  image-placeholder: images/news-placeholder.jpg
  page-size: 10
---

Media appearances, talks, videos and other updates. Use the categories on the right to filter.
